Thanks for the ping, Logan. I reviewed the attached SOW and the customer's MSA. High-level comments:

- Exhibit C vs. standalone SOW: recommend amending Exhibit C (capacity schedule) and attaching the SOW as a scope addendum. That keeps pricing consolidated under the MSA.
- Term/proration: we should add explicit language that capacity increases during an active billing period will be prorated and billed on the next invoice unless otherwise agreed. Proposed clause included in attached mark-up.
- SLA/credits: any higher committed capacity tied to a guaranteed latency SLA should only be added if we have dedicated capacity or a confirmed autoscaling policy. Suggest we add a carveout: "SLA for uplift applies only after dedicated pool is confirmed or autoscaling policy attached."
- Data & audit: tighten retention language (30 -> 90 days for ephemeral logs) for the uplift period; also include standard audit window.
- Indemnity/limitation: no change recommended but any new third-party integrations called out in the SOW should be flagged for legal review.

I'll attach a redline (MSA_ExhibitC_marked.pdf and BrightLeaf_SOW_v2-redline.docx). I'm ok to keep the term to their renewal date but want the proration and SLA carveouts explicit.

Questions for Rishi: are we able to offer a 6% uplift discount on incremental tokens for the first year? If pricing changes materially we should confirm the final numbers before we send to the customer.

Lauren Bishop
